policy.en: Published archives and pinned standards, verified against primary sources. No planned or speculative 2026 course is presented as available. Lab exercises are original; they are not solutions to university assignments. Public reading access does not confer enrollment, grading, certificates or textbook access.
policy.zh: 以下为经原始来源核验的已发布课程档案与固定版本标准，不把计划或推测中的 2026 课程列为可学资源。本 Lab 练习为原创，不是大学原作业的解答。公开阅读不等于获得注册、批改、证书或教材权限。

title.en: Identify the language before judging a contract
title.zh: 先识别方言，再判断契约

goal.en: Separate an interface promise, a data model and its validation language.
goal.zh: 区分接口承诺、数据模型与校验语言。

task.en: Load Nested contract repair. Add pattern to the quantity schema and run. Predict an input error, then remove it. DCL/1 rejects unsupported keywords.
task.zh: 载入“嵌套契约修复”，给 quantity 字段的 Schema 加 pattern 后运行。先预测输入错误，再删除它；DCL/1 会拒绝未知关键字。

expected.en: Unsupported keyword is rejected. No claim of JSON Schema, Pact or ODCS conformance is made.
expected.zh: 未知关键字报错；没有据此声称符合 JSON Schema、Pact 或 ODCS。

title.en: Partition absent, null and typed values
title.zh: 划分缺失、null 与有类型的值

goal.en: Test existence and value constraints independently. SQL NULL is background; JSON absence is a separate state.
goal.zh: 分别测试存在性与值约束。SQL NULL 是背景概念，JSON 属性缺失是另一种状态。

task.en: In the new item's quantity schema, change type to ["integer","null"]. Rerun: null is now allowed; the missing-key row still fails. Then remove the quantity name from that item's required list and rerun.
task.zh: 把新契约数组项中 quantity 的 type 改为 ["integer","null"] 后运行：null 获准，缺键行仍失败。再从该项的 required 列表移除 quantity 字段名，重跑比较。

expected.en: Required + nullable accepts null but rejects absence; optional + non-nullable does the reverse for those two states.
expected.zh: 必填且可空允许 null、拒绝缺失；可选且不可空在这两种状态上的结果相反。

goal.en: Use set inclusion to explain why widening producer outputs can break an existing reader.
goal.zh: 用值集合包含关系解释为什么放宽生产者输出会破坏现有消费方。

task.en: Reload the nested scenario, run, and open the witness. New maximum 9 is accepted by the producer; the old reader allows at most 8. Trace /records/0/quantity~1unit~0.
task.zh: 重新载入嵌套场景，运行并展开反例。新生产者允许 9，旧消费方最多允许 8；定位 /records/0/quantity~1unit~0。

expected.en: New → old: verified counterexample. Old → new: proven inclusion. A wildcard concern path is not the concrete array index in a replay diagnostic.
expected.zh: 新 → 旧有已验证反例；旧 → 新已证明包含。包含关系提示中的数组通配符与回放诊断中的具体下标含义不同。

title.zh: 构造独立判定的反例集

goal.en: Follow a failing nested branch without losing it behind unrelated sibling samples.
goal.zh: 沿着失败的嵌套分支构造反例，避免被无关兄弟属性的样例截断。

task.en: Run U04 offline. Inspect exercises/oracle.mjs: it uses case-specific predicates, not the engine validator. Reverse the property order in a copied corpus case and rerun.
task.zh: 离线运行 U04，查看 exercises/oracle.mjs：它使用逐案例判定式，不调用引擎校验器。复制一个案例，逆序排列属性后重跑。

expected.en: 15 known small separating cases are found; the identical control is proven; a compatible enum case and an oversized witness remain not-proven. These finite cases do not establish completeness.
expected.zh: 15 个已知小反例均可找到；相同契约对照已证明；兼容枚举对照及超预算反例仍为尚未证明。有限案例不能证明搜索完备。

title.en: Repair a promise and replay the same rows
title.zh: 修复承诺，用相同行回放

goal.en: Distinguish producer acceptance, reader acceptance and an actual integration test.
goal.zh: 区分生产者接受、消费方接受与真实集成测试。

task.en: Reload. Set the new item's quantity maximum from 9 back to 8 and rerun. As a separate agreement experiment, reload and change only the consumer maximum to 9. No consumer implementation is executed.
task.zh: 重新载入，把新契约数组项 quantity 的 maximum 从 9 改回 8，重跑。另做一次协商实验：重新载入，只把消费方 maximum 改为 9。本练习不执行消费方应用。

expected.en: Producer repair proves new → reader, but five archived rows still fail both producer contracts. The initially fixed row meant only new-producer acceptance; it still broke the existing reader.
expected.zh: 生产者修复后，新 → 消费方已证明；但五行历史样例仍违反两版生产者契约。初始“已修复行”只表示新生产者接受，该行仍破坏旧消费方。

title.en: Export evidence and check source fidelity
title.zh: 导出证据，核对来源语义

goal.en: Record the exact checked contracts and separate structure from factual correctness.
goal.zh: 记录实际检查的契约，区分结构合法与事实正确。

task.en: After the producer repair, export JSON, CSV and readable HTML. Compare summaries and paths; no raw batch IDs should be present. Run U06: an authored extraction has legal quantity 5 while its source says 6.
task.zh: 生产者修复后导出 JSON、CSV 与可读 HTML，核对摘要与路径，原始 batch ID 不应出现。运行 U06：原创抽取案例结构合法地输出 5，但原始来源是 6。

expected.en: The repaired result survives JSON round-trip; CSV diagnostics match the report. A structural pass does not establish extraction fidelity. This is an offline semantic counterexample, not an LLM benchmark.
expected.zh: JSON 往返保留修复结果，CSV 诊断与报告一致。结构通过不能证明抽取忠实度；这是离线语义反例，不是 LLM 评测。
